context: A uni student listens to a teen friend air a worry
purpose: Teach: 犯し/払わ/許す/かわいそう/始末/はずれ/目立っ/見かける

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、ちょっと聞いてください。クラスに最近見かける子がいて、なんかかわいそうなんです。
lines.en: Senpai, listen for a sec. There's a girl I see in class lately, and she seems kind of pitiful.
lines.style: Teen girl venting, hesitant but eager to open up

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 見かけるって、同じクラスなのに話したことないの?何があったの。
lines.en: You see her? You're in the same class but haven't talked? What happened?
lines.style: University senior, calm and gently probing tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 席が教室のはずれにあって、いつも一人で。先週ちょっとしたミスを犯しちゃって、それで目立っちゃったんです。
lines.en: Her seat's at the far end of the classroom, always alone. Last week she made a small mistake and stood out.
lines.style: Teen explaining, voice softening with sympathy

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほどね。周りはその子に注意を払わずに、放っておいたって感じ?
lines.en: I see. So the people around her didn't pay any attention and just left her be?
lines.style: Older student summarizing thoughtfully, measured pace

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。むしろ笑った子もいて……。私、許す気にはなれなくて、でも声もかけられなくて。
lines.en: Yes. Some even laughed... I can't bring myself to forgive them, but I can't speak up either.
lines.style: Teen conflicted, voice tightening with frustration

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: その気持ちは大事だよ。でも始末をつけるのは周りじゃなくて、まず君が一歩動くことかもね。
lines.en: That feeling matters. But settling this isn't on the others — maybe it starts with you taking a step.
lines.style: Senior offering grounded advice, warm but firm

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 明日、隣の席が空いてたら座ってみます。声、かけてみます。
lines.en: Tomorrow, if the seat next to her is free, I'll sit there. I'll try talking to her.
lines.style: Teen resolved, quiet determination in her voice

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、それでいい。うまくいかなくても、それは挑戦がはずれただけ。何度でも直せるから。
lines.en: Yeah, that's good. Even if it doesn't go well, it's just an attempt that missed. You can fix it as many times as needed.
lines.style: Reassuring senior, closing with gentle encouragement
